findings.fact: DoP reports use Hsotlaw, Tanaing and Chiphwe spellings; inventory uses Tsawlaw, Tanai and Chipwi. Myitkyina District context is supported, but spelling similarity is not an exact source-ID or footprint crosswalk.

Separate official 2014 Panwa and Hsadone Sub-Township reports exist. Their nesting and unions with 2019 Chipwi/Waingmaw source footprints require explicit proof. No area-sum argument or source geometry was used to establish it.

Retained metadata records Chipwi current geometry with one interior ring versus original zero, and both Chipwi/Waingmaw with topology_conflicts=2 and topology_reconciled=true. That display reconciliation note does not supply surveyed inland ownership, exclusion-hole authority or original-footprint retention.

Read-only official profile text does not locate candidate cells against surveyed China-facing boundary pillars, treaty annex sheets or river rules. Retained Puta-O treaty addendum already identifies 1960 treaty Article VII(1) corridor/1961 replacement-map gaps; no repeat treaty fetch performed.

concrete_blockers: Map graphics were not visually inspected in this read-only/no-local-download workflow; exact scale, datum and geographic extent remain unverified.
GAD boundary/drainage text has font-encoding omissions, preventing trustworthy transcription of named boundary lines.
Need official 2019 township/sub-township formation and nesting records for Panwa/Hsadone/Kanpaikit/Shinbwayyan and original-ADM3 crosswalk; missing subprofile URLs were not retried.
Need exact China-boundary protocol/pillar sheets, their datum/control and candidate registration before owner authority can be assessed.
Need inland river bank/channel definitions and documented reason/authority for Chipwi hole and reconciled footprints.
Retained inventory does not provide per-cell temporal interval envelope or exact foreign source-SID feature identities; no inference made.
